author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
Today, I want to show you what life after retirement looks like for many people in China.
Retirement here can be quite different from what you might see in other countries. In many cities, seniors have access to what we call "Senior Universities" or "Elder Schools", community-based programs that offer a wide range of classes, including choir, music, dance, calligraphy, painting, and more.
People join voluntarily, not to earn a degree, but to keep learning, stay active, and connect with others. The idea is simple: to help older adults maintain a fulfilling social life and continue pursuing their interests long after retirement.
